notes: vMLX 1.6.33 — Sessions no longer show a stale red Error badge, or a stale model name, on models that load perfectly well: session runtime status is reconciled at startup so state left behind by a previous run or a crash can never be presented as current. MCP is pinned to the SDK actually shipped in the bundle. The native-MTP control is now driven by the engine's own capability report instead of the bundle name, so families that support MTP render the control and families that do not render nothing. A run that returns only the never-empty notice is now treated as producing no answer rather than passing silently. Plus a batch of release-gate correctness fixes. Both DMGs are Developer ID signed, notarized by Apple, and stapled.
